title: LayoutV1
description: Canonical floor-plan layout exchanged between backend, frontend, and shared fixtures.

units.description: Coordinate and geometry units. The tracer exports metres and the viewer normalizes imported units to metres.

metersPerUnit.description: Metres per input coordinate unit, consistent with units when both are present. Canonical exported geometry uses 1; calibration records whether scale is confirmed or estimated.

scale_m_per_px.description: Source-image calibration provenance; do not multiply geometry already in metres by this value again.

reference.description: Scanned or confirmed dimension text and its source-image span; image coordinates remain in pixels.

measurements.description: Printed annotations with OCR confidence and pixel-coordinate evidence; these do not replace actual room boundaries.

dimension_constraints.description: Automatically matched or manually confirmed dimensions applied jointly to geometry. Endpoint coordinates use layout units; target_m and target_m2 always use SI units.

dimension_constraint_report.description: Residuals from applying exact dimensions. The viewer recomputes actual areas and anchored lengths instead of trusting this cached report.

automatic_scan.description: Automatic scan outcome, applied target counts and unresolved readings retained for review.

geometry_transform.description: Piecewise X/Y coordinate mapping from the initially calibrated geometry to the solved geometry; the original image is not overwritten.

design.description: Optional room-specific local finish previews. Measured room/wall geometry is retained. Ceiling settings, light positions and wall panel region coordinates are in metres; light positions use world X/Z. Raised ceiling profiles remain below room.height.

ceilingAxis.description: Axis across which the ceiling height varies; plan Y is 3D Z.

ceilingLights.description: Locally generated room ceiling fixtures. Attachment elevation is recomputed from the actual ceiling underside; it is not a separately stored, potentially stale Y coordinate.

lumens.description: Requested output for the visual lighting approximation; not a certified photometric result.

dropM.description: Total ceiling-to-bottom depth for pendant/chandelier fixtures (0.1–1.5 m). Other types store 0 and use their fixed model depth.

rotation.description: Fixture rotation in radians about its mounting axis; hanging fixtures remain vertical.

wallPanelRegions.description: Rectangles marked on a room's inside wall faces. Nonempty regions replace legacy full-wall panel coverage; each retains its own panel style. The viewer validates positive bounds, wall association and non-overlap, then clips around actual door/window openings.

wallId.description: Original parent wall ID, not a segment ID created by cutting an opening.

startM.description: Distance along the original wall from wall.start toward wall.end.

endM.description: Distance along the original wall; must exceed startM.

bottomM.description: Lower height above the model floor.

topM.description: Upper height above the model floor; must exceed bottomM.

styleId.description: Catalog style whose category is wallPanel.

boundary_reference.description: inside_faces records that the detected/traced room outline follows inside wall faces.

declared_area_m2.description: Area printed on the plan or supplied by the user, always in square metres; an accepted target is enforced jointly with other dimensions on actual room geometry.

rotationY.description: Yaw about the vertical axis, in radians.
